status: FROZEN - preregistered; not tuned to results

supersedes.reason: v0.1 execution had three identification failures (see identified_failures_v01); v0.2 re-freezes corrected identities, energy-matched RF, and a trajectory/timescale estimand.

identified_failures_v01.title: Cell A ran with wrong HDP config (hp f327f9d2, K_HDP=0.003) instead of intended hp bb8277e7a8e0bca2 (K_HDP=0.0)
identified_failures_v01.detail: exec_A_RFoff_RateRef.py froze FROZEN_HP_HASH='f327f9d2ad64cc88' (the canonical RF-ON hash) and never applied the K_HDP=0.0 override, so the RFoff-standard cell ran with RF-ON plasticity. manifests/four_cell_lifecycle_seal.json also records cell A with hp_hash f327f9d2ad64cc88. The frozen design (jomission/ablations/rf_rate_factorial.py CELL_HP_HASHES) requires A hp bb8277e7a8e0bca2 (K_HDP=0.0).
identified_failures_v01.fix: Corrected A identity (section cells): A must run with hp_hash bb8277e7a8e0bca2 (K_HDP=0.0) and config_hash 4f9fdeae7428199a; the executor asserts the (factor, hp_hash, config_hash) tuple before running; completion predicate P5 re-checks all four cell hashes.

identified_failures_v01.title: RF drive energy imbalance ~185x
identified_failures_v01.detail: RFoff used condition_to_stimulus_schedule(cond, n_neurons=400, drive_amplitude=5.0): uniform 5.0 over all 400 units -> per-trial AAAB L1 energy 42,480,000. RFon used RFOperator.to_stimulus_schedule(tier='graded', base_amplitude=5.0): per-unit amplitude 5.0*(drive/max) over V1 L4 E/PV active units -> 230,181. Ratio 42,480,000/230,181 = 184.55. 'RF' was therefore a compound intervention (config + graded sparse drive + K_HDP), not an isolated, energy-matched retinotopic manipulation.
identified_failures_v01.fix: Energy-matched RF (section energy_matching): frozen per-stimulus amplitude scale A_on(s) such that per-slot L1 drive energy matches the RFoff reference within 1%, verified pre-run.

identified_failures_v01.title: LONG condition measured during relaxation (run-mean timescale/phase confound)
identified_failures_v01.detail: v0.1 reported beta_tau (Rate main) and beta_RFxTau from run-mean H/Theta over the full run. Rate is a rate-only timescale knob (tau_0_ms divides dH/dt only; fixed points invariant per PLASTICITY_RATE_INTERVENTION_DESIGN.md), so the asymptotic Rate effect is ~0 by construction and a run-mean across settled (tau_ref) vs mid-relaxation (tau_LONG, 76% of asymptote at 1202 s) regimes mixes the timescale with the phase of relaxation.
identified_failures_v01.fix: Trajectory/timescale estimand (section trajectory_estimand): D_Theta(t_e) = Theta(t_e; tau_ref) - Theta(t_e; tau_LONG) and DeltaY(t_e) = Y_omission(t_e) - Y_omission(0) at preregistered exposure ages t_e, instead of endpoint run-means.

v01_execution_label_map.note: v0.1 execution used a different B/C ordering than the frozen v0.1 design manifest and the module; v0.2 freezes the design naming and requires runtime (factor, hp_hash, config_hash) assertions per cell.

energy_matching.objective: Sigma_{t,i} I_RFon_i(t) ~= Sigma_{t,i} I_RFoff_i(t) while changing only spatial allocation

reference_rfoff.E_ref_formula: E_ref = (slot_duration_ms / dt_ms) * N_units * A_off = (531.0/0.1) * 400 * 5.0 = 10,620,000 per intact slot

rfon_graded.per_unit_amplitude: amp_u(s) = A_on(s) * (d_u / max_u d_u) for active units with d_u >= 0.2 * max_u d_u (RFConfig.sparsity_threshold=0.2); otherwise no event for unit u
rfon_graded.note: v0.1 measured ratio confirmed live at freeze time

formula.G_s: G(s) = sum over active target units u of d_u(s)/max_u d_u(s)
formula.scaled_slot_energy: E_on(slot;s) = (slot_duration_ms / dt_ms) * sum_u amp_u(s) = (531.0/0.1) * A_on(s) * G(s) = E_ref exactly (by construction)
formula.l1_equivalence: per-slot L1 norm of the materialized 400-unit drive array equals E_on(slot;s) (StimulusSchedule.to_array is additive and per-unit events do not overlap); per-trial L1 equals the sum over intact slots
formula.spatial_allocation_only: only the spatial allocation of the fixed per-slot energy changes (RFoff: uniform 400 units; RFon: graded V1 L4 E/PV units); total per-slot energy is identical

frozen_scale_table.computed_from: RFConfig() (lattice 32x32, 8 dva, sigma_px 1.8, spacing_px 3.2, seed 0, sparsity_threshold 0.2, target V1 L4 E/PV), deterministic at freeze; structural input calibration, not tuned to behavioral/neural results

frozen_constraint.per_slot: for every intact p-slot of every condition, |E_on(slot;s)/E_ref - 1| < 0.01 (relative diff < 1%)
frozen_constraint.omission_slot: E == 0 for every omitted p-slot (temporal geometry preserved, drive zeroed)
verification_pre_run: 1. build model with config_hash 4f9fdeae7428199a; instantiate RFOperator(RFConfig(), model); assert operator.validate() valid (L1 rows, V1 targeting, sparsity, omission zero drive, Jaccard)
2. recompute G(s) and A_on(s); assert |A_on(s) - sealed_value| / sealed_value < 1e-6 (drift guard)
3. for each of the 12 conditions: materialize RFoff (uniform 5.0) and RFon (graded, per-slot A_on(s)) drive arrays via to_array(n_steps=46240, dt_ms=0.1)
4. per p-slot compute L1 energy; assert intact ratio in [0.99, 1.01] and omission ratio == 0
5. write energy_verified receipt (per-slot ratios for all 12 conditions) into the run manifest before the decisive run

jaxfne_capability_confirmed.evidence: jaxfne.StimulusSchedule.to_array source inspected: each event may carry target_indices=[unit] and a distinct amplitude, applied additively to that unit only; RFOperator.to_stimulus_schedule graded tier already emits one event per active unit with amplitude = base_amplitude * normalized_drive (see jomission/network/rf.py to_stimulus_schedule). No engine modification needed.

materialized_verification_at_freeze.note: p4 ratio is 1.001175 if A_on(A) is misapplied to a stimulus-B slot, i.e. within the 1% tolerance, but the frozen design applies the per-stimulus scale exactly

trajectory_estimand.rationale: Replaces v0.1 endpoint run-means, which confounded settled (tau_ref) vs mid-relaxation (tau_LONG) regimes. Rate is rate-only with invariant fixed points, so the timescale hypothesis is a trajectory claim: both cells are measured at matched simulated ages.

estimand_theta.definition: D_Theta(t_e) = Theta(t_e; tau_ref) - Theta(t_e; tau_LONG), seed-matched
estimand_theta.formula: per seed s: D_Theta_s(t_e) = (Theta_A_s(t_e) + Theta_C_s(t_e))/2 - (Theta_B_s(t_e) + Theta_D_s(t_e))/2, i.e. the negative of the Rate-main contrast at age t_e (frozen design naming)
estimand_theta.tau_LONG: tau_0_ms = 1000.0 (tau_eff,E ~833 s, 76% of asymptote at 1202 s)
estimand_theta.source: Theta(t) = HDP weight trajectory recorded at every exposure checkpoint (every 10 trials = 46.24 s), per-neuron and per-area mean, for every cell and seed
estimand_theta.expected_shape: D_Theta(t_e) ~ 0 at t_e = 0, grows as LONG lags REF during relaxation, and decays toward 0 as both approach the shared w* fixed point (rate-only invariance)
estimand_theta.floor_caveat: if |Theta(t)| <= w_floor (0.01) throughout, the Theta estimand is UNRESOLVED (v0.1 adversarial review flagged Theta run-means below floor); the behavioral DeltaY then carries the primary evidence. Do not reinterpret below-floor values as mechanistically meaningful.

estimand_behavioral.definition: DeltaY(t_e) = Y_omission(t_e) - Y_omission(0), within-replicate paired per seed per cell
estimand_behavioral.Y_omission: slot-resolved [0,531] ms omission-vs-intact contrast at position p2/p3/p4, per area, measured by a frozen testing probe at exposure age t_e
phenotypes: rate_omission_effect: mean omission rate - mean intact rate in [0,531] ms, per area V1, V4, FEF, PFC, per position p2/p3/p4
field_low_gamma: log band power (30-50 Hz) omission vs intact in [0,531] ms, per area, per position (proxy_readout, area_local, physical_amplitude_calibrated=False)
field_broadband: 5 bands x 4 areas x 3 positions (secondary, FDR BH)
estimand_behavioral.t_e0: Y_omission(0) = pre-exposure probe; DeltaY(0) = 0 by construction

probe_ages.derivation: t_e = exposure_trial * 4624 ms / 1000; exposure_trial = ceil(t_e_s / 4.624) for t_e > 0
probe_ages.probe_insertion: probe batteries interleave the exposure (which remains 260 trials alternating AAAB/BBBA, identical order for all cells and seeds); probes run with enable_hdp=True and their trials advance simulated age

schedule.phases: pre (96) + exposure (260) + probe_t1 (96) + probe_t2 (96) + probe_t3 (96) + post (96) + recovery (30 s)
schedule.checkpoints: exposure checkpoints every 10 exposure trials (26 checkpoints), atomic-saved with Theta(t) and H(t) trajectory

trajectory_estimand.position_rule: primary per position p2/p3/p4; DO NOT pool p2/p3/p4 before the per-position test; pooled is secondary and flagged

recording_requirement.fixes_v01_gap: v0.1 saved field_proxy only for the first 5 trials of each phase and did not retain slot-resolved [0,531] ms rate/field for all cells (B and D NOT_RECORDED at the rate level; slot-resolved estimand NOT RECOVERABLE). v0.2 records slot-resolved post-phase field low-gamma and per-area rates for ALL cells.

required_per_cell_per_seed.slot_rate: per-trial slot-resolved [0,531] ms per-area (V1, V4, FEF, PFC) firing rates, aligned to each position's expected onset (p2/p3/p4), for every probe trial (intact and omission), for all 5 probes
required_per_cell_per_seed.slot_field_low_gamma: per-trial [0,531] ms low-gamma (30-50 Hz) band power per area per contact (area_local proxy_readout, layout trial_A_C_T, 16 contacts), omission vs intact, for every probe trial, for all 5 probes
required_per_cell_per_seed.theta_h_trajectory: Theta(t) and H(t) per exposure checkpoint (every 10 trials), per-neuron and per-area mean, for D_Theta
required_per_cell_per_seed.finite_state: spikes, V_m, field.lfp_proxy finite; rates in [1,80] Hz; H in [0.1,10]; w in [0.01,10]; V_m mean in [-90,-50] per STABILITY_CRITERIA

recording_requirement.atomic_persistence: each phase (pre, probe_t1, probe_t2, probe_t3, exposure, post, recovery) persisted via jomission.simulation.atomic_save: temp file -> fsync -> sha256 -> atomic os.replace -> manifest receipt, durable before the next phase

seeds.rule: identical seed set across all four cells; within-replicate pairing by seed (same condition order, same RNG, same trial battery); n < 4 or mismatched seed sets across cells -> INCOMPLETE

statistics.model: Y(t_e) ~ RF + Rate + RF:Rate (2-way ANOVA, balanced, orthogonal effect coding), run per t_e, per position, per phenotype; one Y per cell per seed
statistics.type: III (marginal means; for balanced same as II)
statistics.fallback: permutation F (10k) if diagnostics fail, still alpha 0.05

trajectory_interpretation.POSITIVE_timescale: Rate main on DeltaY(t_e) significant (p < .05, |d| > 0.2, |delta| above phenotype threshold) at some t_e >= 200 s AND |Rate effect| non-decreasing across t_e with maximum at t_e3 or t_e4 (LONG still evolving) AND D_Theta(t_e) deviates from 0 consistent with a LONG lag
trajectory_interpretation.NEGATIVE_timescale: no Rate effect at any t_e (all p NS, |delta| below phenotype threshold at all t_e)
trajectory_interpretation.UNRESOLVED: otherwise (underpowered or mixed signs); missing execution/data is UNRESOLVED, never NEGATIVE

RF_interpretation_table.RFonly: RF p<.05, Rate NS, inter NS at t_e4 => RF drives Y, timescale irrelevant
RF_interpretation_table.Rateonly: Rate p<.05 at t_e>=200 with growing trajectory, RF NS => timescale drives Y, RF irrelevant
RF_interpretation_table.additive: both mains p<.05, inter NS => independent additive
RF_interpretation_table.interaction: inter p<.05 => non-additive; examine simple effects Rate|RFon vs Rate|RFoff

multiplicity.primary: no correction across primary phenotype families (each separate claim)
multiplicity.exploratory_broadband_grid: FDR BH across 5 bands x 4 areas x 3 positions per position, secondary

completion_predicate.rule: COMPLETE iff all P1-P6 hold; NEGATIVE results (all p NS) are still COMPLETE if the predicate holds - failures are evidence about the model, not design flaws.

manifest_hash_method: sha256(json.dumps(design_body, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()[:16], where design_body excludes manifest_sha256_16 and manifest_hash_method

probe_semantics.freeze_note: Interleaved 96-trial probe batteries (12 conditions x 8 reps, include omission testing) are STATE-PERTURBING interventions: enable_hdp=True, trials advance simulated age, affecting H/Theta/X/D. They are NOT passive observations.
probe_semantics.protocol: E1 -> P1 -> E2 -> P2 -> E3 -> P3 -> E4 -> P4 -> E5 (exposure segments of alternating AAAB/BBBA, 260 trials total) with probe batteries P1..P4 at t_e in {50.864, 203.456, 601.12}s and P5 at 1202.24s post-exposure; identical insertion applied to ALL four cells and ALL four seeds.
probe_semantics.estinand_interpretation: DeltaY(t_e) and D_Theta(t_e) are measured on the longitudinal (probe-perturbed) trajectory, NOT on a pure unperturbed exposure. The perturbation is common to all cells/seeds (identical probe battery order + seeds), so within-seed contrasts remain valid; the estimand is defined on this frozen protocol.
probe_semantics.alternative_considered: Independent matched trajectories terminated at each t_e would isolate pure-exposure state but require 5x trajectories per cell-seed (~80 runs); rejected for compute cost under the explicit authority that the perturbing protocol is identically applied and frozen.
probe_semantics.who_sees_what: Probe battery trial seeds are matched across cells per seed s (same seed logic as exposure), so probe-induced perturbation is cell-invariant by construction.
